column1: # The loop study's closed-loop arms (README.md, experiment 2 and round 2's G3), in baseline/arms.tsv's format, for
# baseline/baseline_report.py --arms loops/arms.tsv and loops/submit_loops.sh. Every arm runs off_args's pinned zip,
# or (ctrl_t1) that zip with its sampling temperature set to 1.0 by make_t1_zip.py. They run on A100s in resume mode,
# 4 tasks at once on one GPU, unlike the one-task L40S evals of baseline/arms.tsv. So compare these arms with each
# other, not with those runs. {v} is the wheelhouse version; pass k of an arm is <first_run>_r<k>.

column8: off_args with the model's own chat template: the control
off_args with the always-block template: the empty thought prefilled after every tool response
ctrl at temperature 1.0 (Google's sampling: top_p 0.95 as ctrl's, top_k 64 from the model): the zip differs only in configs/sampling.yaml
